claim_limit: Reduced oriented-section mechanics reference with anatomy-derived normalized attachments and model-fitted angular parameters; not measured L1 material mechanics, not a full shell/continuum, and not yet a contact-integrated locomotion validation.
limitations: The section tangent is constrained to the centerline; shear and cross-section warping are not resolved.
Only twist about the tangent is an independent rotational degree of freedom; bending is carried by centerline particles.
The fixture runs in free space and cannot demonstrate locomotion or steering without environmental reaction forces.
Normalized attachment coordinates remain anatomy-derived hypotheses rather than measured L1 3D coordinates.
All force and torque magnitudes use model units, not newtons or newton-metres.
Pressure, anisotropic cuticle elasticity, self-contact, and substrate traction remain future work.
